title: calcearia carinulifera
intro: Calcearia carinulifera, commonly known as Coral Root, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Gentianaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of various health issues. The health benefits of Coral Root include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce swelling, ease pain, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Coral Root include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
